changelog.zh:
- 修复：快速连续切台起播失败/黑屏（open 串行化 + 会话级无画面守卫 + 回退节流）
- 修复：HLG 4K/8K 画面偏亮（改为默认映射，让 HLG OOTF 自然适配 SDR）
- 优化：软解时渲染恒定走 GPU，避免 4K→1080p 降级与色彩偏差
- 优化：设置界面软解模式下联动隐藏无效的硬解方案选项
- 优化：频道支持首尾循环换台
- 优化：8K FCC 缓冲提升（demuxer-max-bytes 10M→64M）
- 补充：回看占位符按 rtp2httpd 规范补齐（|UTC、短格式、timestamp 等）
- 升级：file_picker 至 12.3.0
changelog.en:
- Fixed: fast channel switching startup failure/black screen (serialized open + session-level no-video guard + fallback throttle)
- Fixed: HLG 4K/8K too-bright picture (switch to default mapping, let HLG OOTF adapt to SDR)
- Optimization: software decode now keeps GPU rendering, avoiding 4K→1080p downgrade & color shifts
- Optimization: Settings hide invalid HW-decoder options when Software decode is selected
- Optimization: channel zapping now wraps around at the first/last channel
- Optimization: 8K FCC buffering raised (demuxer-max-bytes 10M→64M)
- Added: catchup placeholders per rtp2httpd spec (|UTC, short-form, timestamps)
- Upgraded: file_picker to 12.3.0
